Commentary.Commentary: Kuldeep Yadav was the pick of the bowlers and Krunal Pandya was also economical in his spell of 4 overs. Khaleel also bowled right lines and lengths. Fabian Allen was the highest scorer with 27. Even Pollard's experience did not help the Windies to post a big score around 150-160. The hosts had a great day with the ball and it is now upto the batsmen to pull this chase comfortably. Stay tuned for the run chase.

Okay then. 109/8 - LOWEST TOTAL BY WINDIES AGAINST INDIA IN T20IS. The Indian bowlers have restricted the visitors to a below par score on this track. The tourists did not apply themselves properly. They lost most wickets due to rash shots. Hope's  run out was the most bizarre thing in the Windies innings.

Deep Dasgupta is interviewing Krunal Pandya. He says that it was a great and proud feeling for him to get the cap and play for his country. Adds that it turned out to be nostalgia for him as he went into yesteryears, remembering all those days when he first started to play cricket. On him dismissing his Mumbai teammate, Pollard, Krunal smiles and says that he will now keep reminding him every time he meets him. On the total, he feels that the bowlers have done their job and it is now upto the batters to do theirs.

FOUR! A boundary to end the proceedings. Windies have managed to play out their 20 overs. A length ball outside off, Pierre swings hard but gets a top edge which goes over short third man, lands on the practice pitches and then scoots away into the fence. WINDIES FINISH ON 109/8.
One more slower delivery, a swing and a miss again.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Another slower ball, Keemo swings again, only to miss.
Slower ball, outside off, Paul swings months early in advance but misses.

RUN OUT MISSED. Full on middle, Pierre whips it towards mid-wicket and Paul keeps on running. Kuldeep Yadav at short mid-wicket dives to his left and stops the ball cleanly, gets up, has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single taken.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl the final over.
FOUR! A length ball on middle, Paul whips it aerially and gets it behind square leg for a boundary! 16 from the over! That has allowed the score to trickle past a 100.
FOUR! SLAM! A short ball, Paul waits for it and pulls it over square leg for a boundary!
Full and around off, Paul hits this really hard, back to the bowler, who has to save his face. The ball deflects off his palm towards long on and they scamper back for two.
Down the leg side, Khary looks to flick but the ball goes off his thigh pads towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
EDGED, FOUR! Landed outside off, Pierre looks to guide it towards third man but gets a thick outside edge which eludes the diving Dinesh Karthik to the third man fence.
A full toss, swung towards long on for a single.
Khary Pierre, one of the two debutants remaining, comes on to bat at number 10.

OUT! Maiden T20I wicket for Khaleel now. Windies are 8 down and there are still 2 overs left. Short delivery, the batsman pulls it towards mid-wicket and gets caught by Umesh Yadav who was waiting for the catch.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.

TOP EDGE, FOUR! That is a lucky boundary but Windies will take all that they can get. Good length delivery outside off stump, Fabian looks to pull but gets a top edge over short third man and it goes for a boundary.
Short delivery on middle stump, Fabian pulls it towards mid-wicket and it goes straight towards the fielder. The batsmen get a single.
Again bowls a slower one, Fabian gets an inside edge into his pads. The batsmen pick up a single.
Bowls a slower one outside off stump, Allen comes forward and misses the shot.
Khaleel Ahmed to bowl the 18th over.
A yorker, around middle, worked through mid-wicket for one. 11 from the over. Not a bad one from Bumrah though.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.
Full and down the leg side, Paul backs away, looking to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Full and outside off, Allen backs away and drives it down the ground. Manish Pandey gives it a good chase from long on, gets to the ball and then dives to flick it back in. Three runs taken.
Another swing, a top edge induced but it does not carry to long on. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Heave-ho from Allen. A length ball on middle, Allen swings it over mid-wicket where some poor piece of fielding aids the ball into the ropes.
Jasprit Bumrah returns as well. 2-0-10-1 so far.
Full on middle, driven straight back for a single.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Comes down the track and looks to bunt it towards long on but gets an inside edge.
The batsman has lofted it over mid on. They pick up a single.

DROPPED, FOUR! Should have taken that. Full and outside off, Allen swings this high into the night sky. Lokesh Rahul calls for it from long on, runs to his left, gets to the ball but puts it down. Concedes a boundary as well.
Umesh Yadav returns. 2-0-14-1 so far.

SAFE. PITCHED OUTSIDE LEG. Flighted delivery, Paul tries to defend but misses and gets hit on the pad. Umpire gives it not out and India decide to review it. The hosts lose their review. Not the greatest of reviews.
Keemo Paul comes in at number 9, replacing Brathwaite. And is he gone first ball? A review has been taken for LBW. He was adjudged not out by the on-field umpire.

OUT! Plumb LBW. The skipper is gone. Tossed up again on leg stump, the batsman tried to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The umpire raises the dreaded finger and Carlos does not bother to review.
Tossed up on middle stump, Carlos defends on the front foot.
Tossed up again outside off stump, Fabian hits it towards leg side and gets a single.
The batsman has been hit on the pads as he tried to sweep that one.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off stump, Allen dances down the track and hits it over long on for a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fuller and around off, Brathwaite is squared up, looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge towards point. A run stolen.
Outside off, played towards point.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
That's hit the batsman on his pads.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Fabian gets beaten on this one.
Tossed up again on off stump, Allen defends on the back foot.
Tossed up on off stump, Allen defends on the front foot.
Time for the bowlers. Here comes Fabian Allen. Okay, he is an all-rounder.

OUT! Number 6 is down! The googly from Kuldeep, outside off, fuller in length, Powell looks to drive but the bat hits his shoe and the ball takes the outside edge. Brilliant catch from Karthik behind. Sorry state for the Windies. Oh dear... it will be even worse when Rovman sees the replays in the dressing room. SNICKOMETER DETECTS NOTHING WHEN THE BALL PASSES THE BAT. There is a review available...
Down the leg side, Brathwaite misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads through fine leg. A leg bye taken.
IN THE AIR... SAFE! Full and around off, Powell looks to play the slog sweep but gets a top edge. Luckily for him, it does not carry to the man running in from deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for a single. Spoils what could have been a maiden. Superb spell of bowling though.
5TH DOT IN A ROW! Are we going to see a maiden? Fuller on middle, pushed towards long on but Pandya gets across to his right and stops it.
Another faster one, pushed towards Krunal once more.
The quicker one, punched back to Krunal again.
Similar ball, another tight defense.
Full and around off, pushed towards the bowler.
Flighted delivery on off stump, the batsman drives it towards point. The batsmen get a couple.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Rovman sweeps from outside off stump and it runs towards square leg. The batsman get a single.
Tossed up on middle stump, Powell defends on the back foot.
Bowls quicker on leg stump, Carlos pushes it to mid-wicket for a single. 50 up for Windies.
Remember the name. Ian Bishop had said this in 2016. Not quite done much worth remembering since then. Here's Carlos Brathwaite.

OUT! Half the side is down now! Poor cricket from Windies. Poor cricket from Bravo. All sorts of shambles and India are not even being allowed to bowl well. Wickets are being handed on a platter. The one man who could have perhaps batted out the 20 overs has been dismissed a ball after the 10th. Full on middle, Darren looks to swing it over long on but barely gets to the pitch of the ball. He finds Shikhar Dhawan at the ropes who takes it smartly, with a leap to his right.
Flighted delivery on middle stump, Bravo hits it behind square leg for a single.
Tossed up again on middle stump, the batsman gets a single towards mid on.
Bowls quick on off stump, Rovman hits it towards point.
Tossed up on leg stump, Rovman pushes it behind square leg for a single.
Rovman Powell is the next man in, at number 6, replacing Pollard.

OUT! Straight to the man! Oh dear... oh dear... oh dear... Windies are in all sorts of trouble. Fuller in length, slightly slower, Pollard tries a repeat of his previous six but this time, the ball arrives a bit late and he is already through his shot. It goes off the inner half of the bat and lobs towards long on where Manish Pandey takes it calmly. 4 down, nearly half the overs bowled and the score is not even half of what can be called as the par score at Eden. Trouble.
The arm ball, skidding on, Pollard misses his flick and is rapped up on the pads. An LBW appeal ensues but that seemed to be missing leg.
On middle and leg, flicked through fine leg for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and around off, driven straight back.
Beautifully bowled, floated around off, Bravo taps it with soft hands to the off side for a run.
Full and around off, well blocked out.
Full toss on middle, perhaps Pollard was surprised. Just pushed it towards long on for a single.
Spin from both ends. Here's Kuldeep.
Beautiful delivery, drifts on off stump, Darren tries to cut towards third man but the ball misses the edge by a whisker.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
SIX! When this man hits, they usually stay hit. Hardly any power. Just stand and deliver. Tossed up on middle stump, Pollard lofts it over long on for a beautiful six.
Another WIDE! Again down the leg side, same reaction from Pollard.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Pollard left it alone.
Flighted delivery on off stump, Pollard defends on the front foot.
Tossed up on leg stump, Darren flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Time for spin. Krunal Pandya to bowl the first over in that department.
On middle and off, watchfully kept out.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
On a length around middle, seaming away, Bravo has a push but misses.
Outside off, pushed towards mid off for a quick run.
On a length outside off, pushed towards point.
Full and around off, driven through the covers for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball on the back foot. Good Powerplay for India and West Indies are 31/3.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Short delivery on off stump again, same reaction from the batsman.
Good short delivery on off stump, Pollard defends on the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full delivery on leg stump, Pollard flicks it behind square leg. Umesh chases it from short fine leg and stops it. The batsmen run a couple.
A peach to end! On a length and angles across the batsman. Bravo plays inside the line and is beaten.
Pollard works it around the corner and takes a run.
Darren Bravo is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... taken! Three wickets in three overs. Not a lot of teams win the game after losing three in the Powerplay. The bouncer does the trick. It is short and it hurries the batsman. Hetmyer goes for the pull but the ball takes the top edge and lobs high in the air towards short fine leg. Karthik runs towards the ball, calls for it as Khaleel there is also interested. He lets it be for the keeper as he has the gloves on and Dinesh takes it with ease. Bumrah strikes in his first over and the Windies slip further.

FOUR! That has raced across the turf! On the shorter side, Hetmyer pulls it through mid-wicket and the ball races away. It is just a matter of beating the fielders in the rin, there is no stopping the ball after that.
Walks down the track and works it around the corner for a single.
On the pads, Hetmyer works it through mid-wicket and a run is taken.
Jasprit Bumrah is on.
Yes, he can! A decent nut to end the over. On a length and around off, Pollard tries to defend but the ball pitches and moves away. Beats the outside edge of Pollard's bat.
A little too wide outside off, Pollard does not go after it. Can he bowl a maiden here?
A bumper on middle, Pollard evades it. 4 dots so far.
A little too wide outside off, left alone.
Fuller in length around middle, Pollard keeps it out.
Kieron Pollard walks in to face the music now.

OUT! RUN OUT! Comedy of errors there. Hope flicks it towards mid-wicket. He then thinks of a run, takes a few steps ahead. Hetmyer responds first but then seeing Hope stop, he turns and runs back. Hope does not see that as he was watching the ball and runs towards Hetmyer's end. Rahul collects the ball and his throw is a poor one as it is above the keeper. However, Manish Pandey shows great match awareness as he is backing up. Comes running in from point, collects the ball and dislodges the bails. The umpires though are not sure as to who is run out. They go upstairs to find out and replays show, it is Hope who has to walk back. So, two wickets in two overs for the Windies and they are in a spot of bother.
On the pads, Hope flicks it, there is a man at deep square leg, so just a run. 6 runs and a wicket from Umesh's second.
Plays this nicely towards covers for a quick run.
Ohkay, so Hetmyer has decided to go after the bowlers. He tries to go over mid on this time. There is no timing on it and it goes on a couple of bounces to the fielder there.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! It was a length ball outside off, Shimron moves his front leg out of the way and lofts it straight back over the bowler's head. Boundary.
Almost gets another! What a peach! On a length around off, it comes back in sharply. Hetmyer fails to adjust and it cuts him into half.
Shimron Hetmyer walks out to the middle.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Ramdin starts to walk there and India draw first blood. A tentative push. No foot movement and it was played away from his body. That brings about the downfall of Ramdin. It was an outswinger outside off and on a length. Ramdin hangs his bat out. The ball takes the edge and goes into the mitts of Karthik.
FOUR! Spoils the over! 8 from the second also. Down the leg side, Hope puts it away with a flick shot. It races to the fine leg fence.
A single as Ramdin taps it towards point.  Good running.
No swing this time and he angles this across the batsman. It is stroked towards covers.
Now swings this one back in. Varying it really well here is Khaleel. It is on middle, Hope strokes it towards wide mid on for a run.
Edged but a run! Excellent bowling. Angles this one across the batter. Ramdin plays inside the line and gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
Goes full and gets it to nip back in slightly. Ramdin strokes it to mid on. He played it with the swing there.
WIDE! False start by Ahmed. He bowls it down the leg side and it has been wided.
Khaleel Ahmed to bowl from the other end.
A dot to end! So 8 runs from the first over. Good start for Windies. This is on a length, Hope tries to go over the mid off fielder but the ball takes an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! But he is putting away the bad balls. Short and it sits up to be hit. Hope rocks back quickly and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Second of the first over.
Once again it is a length ball around off, Hope is happy to block it out. So the batsman has started watchfully.
Pulls it back and lands it on a length around off, Hope defends it.

FOUR! Windies are underway! A poor effort in the field sees them open their tally with a boundary. Slightly fuller in length and there is not a lot of swing this time. Hope strokes it through extra cover. Pandya from mid off hares after it. He slides and tries to stop it with his left hand but unfortunately, the ball hits his right hand and creeps towards the ropes.
And straightaway he is on the money. Also gets some shape away but that came onto the bat really nicely. On a length and around off, shapes away. Hope goes back and guides it off the middle to point.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems and the bell here at the Eden Gardens has been rung by Mohammad Azharuddin, which means we are all set for the action to begin. The Indians make their way out to the middle. Shai Hope and Denesh Ramdin are the openers. The former will take strike and he will Umesh Yadav who has the new ball in hand. Here we go...
The players make their way out for their respective National Anthems. The visitors sing their first, followed by the Indians.

Windies skipper, Carlos Brathwaite, says he wanted to bowl first as well as the dew plays a key role in the second innings. Adds further they will try to enjoy the game. Informs they have a few debutants with a few experienced players as well. Ends by saying, they have three debutants, Oshane Thomas, Khary Perry and Fabian Allen. Ends by saying, Khary Perry is an exciting prospect.

Indian skipper, Rohit Sharma, says this ground always favors the team chasing as the dew plays a massive role in the second half. Mentions they have to do the basics right and adapt to the shorter version as soon as possible. Further adds it is very important to know your role. Informs bhuvneshwar Kumar and Yuzvendra Chahal misses out, Umesh Yadav comes in and Kurnal Pandya is making his debut.
Toss - India win the toss and they elect to field.

Sunil Gavaskar doing the pitch report observes that the track looks quite hard with a few cracks. Reckons that the ball will come on to the bat quite nicely and play on the rise on this surface.  But also feels that the odd ball will grip and turn.

India on the flip side are without their original skipper, Virat Kohli. Despite that they are a team full of superstars. They are just about favorites as they are playing in familiar conditions. With two heavyweights of this format clashing, we can surely expect a cracking encounter.

Hello and welcome to the first T20I between India and the Windies. A new format and one in which the latter are a force to reckon. They are missing a few big name players but still have a number of match winners.
